question: is a clicked point on the map arithmetic or retrieval
note: every click averages the k nearest MAPPED photographs, so no click reads empty space. Novelty is the averaged vector's best match in the gallery, expressed as a percentile of the cosine real photographs achieve with their own nearest neighbour. Low percentile means the point sits where no photograph sits.
